entries: **Context-window nudge reframed around quality, and fires earlier (≥70%)**: the status line reminder added in 0.20.0 was framed around cost, but Claude Code (and Codex) auto-compact at ~80% and prompt caching makes resent context cheap — so the cost angle added little. What actually degrades as a conversation grows is quality: models lose the middle of long inputs well before the window fills. The nudge now triggers at 70% — ahead of the lossy automatic compaction — and suggests taking control yourself: `/clear` when switching tasks, or `/compact` to keep the focus you choose. The dollar figure was dropped.

title.zh-TW: 脈絡視窗提醒改幫你顧品質，而且提早發出
title.en: Context window nudge refocused on quality and triggers earlier

body.zh-TW: 之前提醒你清理對話的脈絡視窗（context，AI 能記住的前後文範圍）通知，現在會提早在 70% 就跳出來，而且不再跟你算錢，而是幫你顧品質。因為模型在脈絡被塞滿之前，就會開始忘記長對話中段的內容。所以現在它會趕在品質開始掉之前提醒你：切換任務可以用 `/clear`，想繼續做可以用 `/compact` 保留重點。就像讀書一樣，與其等大腦完全塞滿才喊停，不如在裝到七分滿、開始恍神前，就先把重點整理下來。
body.en: The notification nudging you to clean up your chat's context window (context — the range of previous messages the AI remembers) now jumps out earlier at 70%, and it no longer bothers lecturing you on costs, but focuses on preserving quality. This is because the model starts forgetting the middle parts of long conversations well before the context is actually full. So now it warns you right before quality drops: use `/clear` when switching tasks, or `/compact` if you want to continue but keep the focus. It's like studying: rather than waiting until your brain is 100% full to take a break, it's better to pause at 70%—before you start spacing out—and summarize the key points.

entries: **Status line nudges `/clear` when the context window goes heavy (≥80%)**: once a Claude Code conversation fills its context window past the red zone, the status line appends a one-line reminder. Past that point every turn resends a heavy context — pricier turns and a faster rate-limit burn, both of which `/clear` resets. The nudge shows the context % and, when available, the session cost, in all five languages.

**Codex 5h quota no longer goes stale on long-lived sessions**: the rate-limit reader scanned Codex session files newest-date-directory first and stopped at a scan limit, which could skip the file that was *actually* modified most recently when a long session keeps appending to an older creation-date directory. It now sorts all visible session files by modification time, so the menu bar always reflects the newest snapshot. (#37, by @ericweichun)

title.zh-TW: 脈絡視窗太重時會跳出提醒，教你怎麼清空
title.en: Status line nudges when context is too heavy and teaches you how to clear it

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude Code 對話把脈絡視窗（context，AI 能記住的前後文範圍）塞到 80% 以上的紅區時，狀態列現在會補上一行提醒。因為過了這個點，每一輪對話都會把沉重的紀錄重送一次，讓每輪成本更貴，額度也燒得更快；這時候輸入 `/clear` 就能把包袱清掉重置。提醒還會顯示脈絡百分比與本次對話花費。就像你的背包快塞滿時，系統會拍拍你的肩膀，建議你把用不到的東西清掉再繼續走。
body.en: When a Claude Code conversation packs its context window (context — the range of previous messages the AI remembers) past the 80% red zone, the status line now appends a one-line reminder. Past this point, every turn resends a heavy log, making each turn more expensive and causing your quota to burn faster; typing `/clear` lets you drop the baggage and reset. The nudge also shows the context percentage and your session cost. It's like having a system tap you on the shoulder when your backpack is nearly full, suggesting you empty out what you don't need before hiking further.

Past that point every turn resends a heavy context — pricier turns and a faster rate-limit burn, both of which `/clear` resets. title.zh-TW: 長時間的 Codex 對話，5 小時額度數字不再抓錯
title.en: Long Codex sessions no longer show stale 5-hour quotas

body.zh-TW: 以前如果一個 Codex 工作階段（session，一段連續的對話期間）聊太久，系統在抓 5 小時額度數字時，可能會漏看真正最新被修改的檔案，導致選單列顯示過期的數字。現在系統會把所有看得到的檔案照最後修改時間排序，確保選單列永遠反映最新狀況。就像看行事曆，以前只照建立時間排、漏了後來才更新的記事，現在直接照最後更新時間排，保證你看到的是最新進度。
body.en: Previously, if a Codex session (session — one continuous stretch of a conversation) went on for too long, the system fetching the 5-hour quota could overlook the file that was actually modified most recently, causing the menu bar to show stale numbers. Now, the system sorts all visible files by their last modified time, ensuring the menu bar always reflects the latest snapshot. It's like checking a planner: you used to sort entries only by when they were created and missed ones updated later, but now you sort straight by last updated, ensuring you always see the freshest progress.

entries: **Hidden Claude Code section no longer leaks a setup error**: Codex-only users who hid the Claude Code section still saw a "status file not found — run `python3 main.py --setup`" message in the popover footer, plus an "Install Hook" button. Both are Claude Code-specific and are now suppressed while the section is hidden; the footer falls back to a neutral synced status. (#36, reported by @ilss0902)

title.zh-TW: 隱藏 Claude Code 區塊後，底部的錯誤提示不會再出來嚇人
title.en: Hiding the Claude Code section finally silences its leftover setup errors

body.zh-TW: 當你把 Claude Code 區塊隱藏起來時，系統不會再莫名其妙跳出錯誤訊息了。以前如果你只用 Codex，把 Claude Code 隱藏掉，面板最底下還是會顯示找不到狀態檔的錯誤，甚至還會冒出一顆叫你「安裝 Hook」的按鈕，讓人一頭霧水；現在系統學乖了，只要區塊被隱藏，這些專屬於 Claude Code 的警告也會一起乖乖消失，底部只會顯示乾淨的中性同步狀態。就像你已經把一輛破車報廢了，車庫的儀表板就不該還在天天亮紅燈叫你換機油，現在它終於懂得閉嘴了。
body.en: When you hide the Claude Code section, the system will no longer pop up confusing error messages. Previously, if you only used Codex and hid Claude Code, the bottom of the panel would still panic about a missing status file and even surface an "Install Hook" button, leaving users scratching their heads; the system has wised up, so when the section is hidden, these Claude Code-specific warnings are fully suppressed alongside it, and the footer smoothly falls back to a clean, neutral sync status. Like scrapping a broken car but the garage's master dashboard still flashes a red light begging you to change the oil every day — it finally knows to stay quiet.

entries: **Hide Claude Code section**: a new "Hide Sections ▸" submenu in the Switch Panel menu lets you hide Claude Code and Codex independently, so Codex-only users can hide the Claude Code card from every panel theme and the Claude Code percentage from the menu bar (Codex then leads the readout). Every panel keeps its "Switch Panel" button reachable — when the Claude Code card is hidden, the button moves to the next visible card. (#35, requested by @ilss0902)

**Hiding a provider now also hides its percentage from the menu bar** (previously "Hide Codex Section" only hid the popover card). With both providers hidden, the paw icon stays in the menu bar as the click target.

**Shorter settings menu**: the "Automatically Check for Updates" row is gone — update checks simply stay on by default (still honored if disabled in `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`), and the two hide toggles are consolidated into the "Hide Sections ▸" submenu.

title.zh-TW: 可以徹底隱藏沒在用的 AI 工具，選單也變簡潔了
title.en: Completely hide unused AI tools and enjoy a shorter settings menu

body.zh-TW: 如果你只用某一套 AI 工具，現在可以讓畫面更乾淨了。「更換面板」選單裡多了一個「隱藏區塊」的功能，讓你可以自由隱藏 Claude Code 或是 Codex。隱藏之後，不只面板上的卡片會消失，連選單列上的百分比也會跟著不見，讓剩下的那套工具直接排在最前面（如果你把兩套都隱藏了，選單列上還是會保留一個小爪子圖示讓你點擊）。而且不用擔心找不到設定按鈕，當第一張卡片被隱藏時，換面板的按鈕會自動搬家到下一張卡片上。同時，設定選單也變短了，多餘的「自動檢查更新」開關被拿掉（系統預設會在背景自動檢查），隱藏開關也都收合在一起。就像一間工具箱，以前就算你不用扳手，它也硬生生佔著最顯眼的位置；現在你可以把不用的工具收進暗格裡，讓最常用的那把螺絲起子直接擺在最順手的地方。
body.en: If you only use one AI tool, you can now make the interface much cleaner. The "Switch Panel" menu now features a "Hide Sections" submenu, allowing you to independently hide Claude Code or Codex. Once hidden, not only does the tool's card disappear from the popover, but its percentage also vanishes from the menu bar, bumping your remaining tool straight to the front (if you hide both, a little paw icon remains so you can still click it). You also don't have to worry about losing the settings button; if the first card is hidden, the button automatically moves to the next visible card. At the same time, the settings menu has gotten shorter: the redundant "Automatically Check for Updates" toggle is gone (the system handles it silently by default), and the hide toggles are neatly grouped together. Like a toolbox that used to force a wrench into the spotlight even if you never used it — now you can tuck unused tools into a hidden drawer, keeping your favorite screwdriver right where you need it.

Every panel keeps its "Switch Panel" button reachable — when the Claude Code card is hidden, the button moves to the next visible card. (#35, requested by @ilss0902)
**Hiding a provider now also hides its percentage from the menu bar** (previously "Hide Codex Section" only hid the popover card). With both providers hidden, the paw icon stays in the menu bar as the click target.
**Shorter settings menu**: the "Automatically Check for Updates" row is gone — update checks simply stay on by default (still honored if disabled in `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`), and the two hide toggles are consolidated into the "Hide Sections ▸" submenu.

entries: **Health-check diagnosis on every new conversation**: usage now runs a background diagnosis engine against your Claude Code session logs and, when it finds meaningful waste, quietly appends a one-line reminder to the Progress Concierge's opening handoff. Say "show me" and the model reads the full snapshot (`~/.claude/usage-diagnosis.json`) and explains findings with specific suggestions. The reminder is suppressed for 7 days once a fingerprint is seen, re-surfaces when the diagnosis changes, and is skipped entirely when the snapshot is stale (>48 h).

**Five-rule diagnosis engine** (`analyzer/diagnoser.py`): detects repeated file reads, polluter directories (node_modules, .venv, dist, …), anomalous session sizes, noisy Bash output, and repeated Bash commands. Findings are ranked by estimated token waste so the most actionable finding is always surfaced first.

**Daily diagnosis snapshot** (`usage_diagnosis_snapshot.py`): the menu-bar app refreshes `~/.claude/usage-diagnosis.json` once per day in the background so the cost estimate is always fresh when you open a new conversation.

**Anomaly-session waste estimates are no longer inflated ~9×**: the engine previously counted the entire token total of an anomalous session as waste and priced every token at the full $3/MTok input rate. Long sessions are dominated by cache reads billed at a tenth of that ($0.30/MTok), and the work done in the session isn't waste at all — only the excess over the project baseline is. Cost is now split by token type and scaled to the excess share (real-data result: $254 → $27).

title.zh-TW: 每次開新對話都會幫你抓漏，省下不必要的開銷
title.en: Opening a new conversation now runs a health check to stop quota leaks

body.zh-TW: 每次你開啟新的 Claude Code 對話時，系統都會在背景默默幫你的紀錄做一次健康檢查，如果發現你在白白浪費額度，進度管家就會在開場白最後悄悄補上一句提醒。只要你回覆「看」，系統就會讀取每天在背景自動更新一次的快照（`~/.claude/usage-diagnosis.json`），把哪裡浪費、該怎麼改詳細解釋給你聽。同一個問題提醒過後，7 天內都不會再吵你，直到出現新問題才會再提醒；如果快照太舊（超過 48 小時），它也會識趣地直接略過。就像每次出車前技師都會偷偷幫你檢查底盤，發現漏油才小聲提醒你，而且講過一次就不會天天碎唸，免得你嫌煩。
body.en: Every time you open a new Claude Code conversation, the system now quietly runs a background health check on your logs; if it spots you burning quota pointlessly, the Progress Concierge will slip a one-line reminder at the end of its opening greeting. Just reply "show me," and the model will read the snapshot (updated daily in the background to `~/.claude/usage-diagnosis.json`) to explain exactly what's wasting tokens and how to fix it. Once reminded about a specific issue, it won't pester you about it again for 7 days unless a new diagnosis appears; if the snapshot is too old (over 48 hours), it will smartly skip the warning altogether. It's like a mechanic doing a quick inspection under your car before every trip — they only tap your shoulder if there's an oil leak, and they won't nag you about the same puddle every single day.

The reminder is suppressed for 7 days once a fingerprint is seen, re-surfaces when the diagnosis changes, and is skipped entirely when the snapshot is stale (>48 h).
**Daily diagnosis snapshot** (`usage_diagnosis_snapshot.py`): the menu-bar app refreshes `~/.claude/usage-diagnosis.json` once per day in the background so the cost estimate is always fresh when you open a new conversation.

title.zh-TW: 診斷規則更聰明，不再誇大浪費的金額
title.en: Smarter diagnosis rules stop inflating your wasted money

body.zh-TW: 現在系統能更精準地幫你抓出浪費，不再拿天價數字嚇你了。系統加裝了五大規則引擎（會抓出重複讀檔、掃到 `node_modules` 等垃圾目錄、對話過度膨脹、終端機輸出太長、重複跑指令），並會把最該修的浪費排在最前面告訴你。同時，當它發現對話太長時，不會再像以前那樣傻傻把所有字都用最貴的費率算成「浪費」，搞出誇大 9 倍的天價；現在它懂得區分哪裡是你已經快取（cache，省下重複計算的暫存紀錄）的便宜字數，並且只把「超出正常水準」的部份算成浪費。就像計程車跳表機，以前一繞路就把整趟車資當成損失來嚇你，現在它會精準算出「只算繞路多跑的里程」，而且會幫你扣掉會員打折的費用，給你一張公道精準的收據。
body.en: The system now flags your wasted tokens much more precisely and stops scaring you with wildly inflated estimates. We've armed the engine with five core rules (flagging repeated file reads, scanning trash directories like `node_modules`, anomalous session bloat, massive terminal outputs, and repeated bash commands), ensuring the most pressing waste is always surfaced first. Additionally, when it detects an overly long session, it no longer foolishly bills every single word at the most expensive rate and calls the entire session "waste", which used to inflate estimates by 9 times; it now smartly separates out your cheap cached (temporarily saved to skip recalculations) tokens, and only counts the exact portion that exceeds your project's baseline as actual waste. Like a taxi meter that used to point at the total fare and call the whole trip a loss just because the driver took one wrong turn — now it calculates exactly the few miles of the detour and applies your membership discount, handing you a fair and precise receipt.

Findings are ranked by estimated token waste so the most actionable finding is always surfaced first.
**Anomaly-session waste estimates are no longer inflated ~9×**: the engine previously counted the entire token total of an anomalous session as waste and priced every token at the full $3/MTok input rate. Long sessions are dominated by cache reads billed at a tenth of that ($0.30/MTok), and the work done in the session isn't waste at all — only the excess over the project baseline is. Cost is now split by token type and scaled to the excess share (real-data result: $254 → $27).

entries: **Lepidoptera panel no longer shifts when the project list is empty**: the panel was vertically centered, so with no project data the cards floated to the middle of the popover and jumped when projects appeared. It now top-aligns like the other panels, with the project card absorbing the extra height, so the layout stays stable whether or not projects are listed.

title.zh-TW: 蝶類圖鑑面板在沒有專案時不再亂跳
title.en: The Lepidoptera panel no longer jumps around when the project list is empty

body.zh-TW: 新增的蝶類圖鑑面板現在不管有沒有專案資料，版面都會穩如泰山。以前這個面板的內容是垂直置中的，當你還沒有任何專案資料時，面板上的卡片會直接飄到視窗正中間，等專案一出現又會突然跳回原本的位置；現在它已經改成跟其他面板一樣靠上對齊，多出來的空間會被專案卡片自然填滿。就像原本掛在牆上的畫因為沒釘好而滑到中間，現在把它牢牢釘在頂部，不管底下多掛幾幅畫都不會走位。
body.en: The new Lepidoptera panel will now stay rock solid regardless of whether you have project data. Previously, this panel was vertically centered, meaning if you had no projects listed, the cards would float to the exact middle of the popover and then suddenly jump back when projects appeared; it now top-aligns exactly like the other panels, with the project card naturally absorbing any extra space. Like a framed picture that used to slide to the middle of a wall because it wasn't nailed properly, it's now firmly anchored at the top and won't shift no matter how many other pictures you hang below it.

It now top-aligns like the other panels, with the project card absorbing the extra height, so the layout stays stable whether or not projects are listed.

entries: **New "Lepidoptera" panel theme**: a cyanotype blueprint plate inspired by the Fable 5 launch — deep Prussian-blue ground with a cyan engineering grid, the Claude Code and Codex logos mounted in cyan registration frames, monospace engineering readouts, corner crop marks, and white technical line-art butterflies drawn as schematics (construction circles, centerlines, wingspan dimensions) that drift and beat their wings across the panel. Pick it from "Switch Panel". Honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.

title.zh-TW: 新增「蝶類圖鑑」面板，把你的用量變成工程藍圖
title.en: New "Lepidoptera" panel turns your usage into an engineering blueprint

body.zh-TW: 你現在可以把用量面板換成充滿科技感的「蝶類圖鑑」（Lepidoptera）主題了。這款新面板致敬了 Fable 5 發表的藍曬工程圖風格——在深普魯士藍的底色上，畫滿了青色的工程方格與裁切標記，並把 Claude Code 與 Codex（兩套 AI 工具）的標誌嵌進青色的定位框裡，數字也全換成等寬的工程字體。最酷的是，畫面上會有多隻用白色技術線稿畫成的蝴蝶（帶有構造圓、中軸線和翼展尺寸標註），牠們會在面板上緩緩拍動翅膀並四處飄移（如果你會暈眩，開啟系統的減少動態設定就能讓牠們停下來）。就像把原本枯燥的報表，換成一張從科幻電影裡拿出來、還有全息蝴蝶在上面飛舞的精密設計圖。你可以從「更換面板」裡選用它。
body.en: You can now switch your usage panel to the high-tech "Lepidoptera" theme. This new panel pays homage to the cyanotype blueprint style of the Fable 5 launch — on a deep Prussian-blue background, it draws a cyan engineering grid with corner crop marks, mounts the Claude Code and Codex (two AI tools) logos into cyan registration frames, and uses monospace engineering fonts for all readouts. Best of all, white technical line-art butterflies (drawn as schematics with construction circles, centerlines, and wingspan dimensions) will drift and beat their wings across the panel (if motion makes you dizzy, turning on your system's reduced motion setting will keep them still). It's like replacing a boring spreadsheet with a precision schematic straight out of a sci-fi movie, complete with holographic butterflies flying over it. You can pick it from the "Switch Panel" menu.

entries: **Cleaner project list on more panels**: removed the redundant row separators on the Matrix, Newspaper, and Windows 95 panels — each already shows a per-project usage bar, so projects are now divided by that bar alone, matching the default panel. (Panels that rely on separators instead of a usage bar are unchanged.)

title.zh-TW: 更多面板的專案清單變得更乾淨
title.en: Cleaner project lists on even more panels

body.zh-TW: 駭客任務、報紙、Windows 95 這三個面板現在看起來更清爽了。因為這些面板本來就會幫每個專案畫一條用量進度條，系統就把原本夾在中間多餘的列分隔線拿掉了；現在只靠那條用量條來區分專案，跟預設面板一樣乾淨俐落（至於本來就沒有用量條的面板，還是會保留分隔線）。就像一本已經有明顯段落標題的書，現在把段落之間多餘的橫線都擦掉，讓版面不再眼花撩亂。
body.en: The Matrix, Newspaper, and Windows 95 panels now look much cleaner. Since these panels already draw a usage progress bar for each project, the system has completely dropped the redundant row separators squeezed between them; projects are now cleanly divided by that usage bar alone, just like the default panel (panels that naturally lack a usage bar will still keep their separators). It's like taking a book that already has clear paragraph headings and erasing all the unnecessary horizontal lines between them, making the page much easier to read.

body.zh-TW: 現在你能順利透過 Homebrew 安裝這套軟體了。以前用 formula（給純文字終端機指令用的套件格式）安裝這個圖形介面 App 時，會因為壓縮檔解開後路徑重疊跳出 `Errno::ENOENT` 錯誤而徹底失敗；現在改用 cask（專給 macOS 圖形介面軟體用的套件格式）發佈，不只徹底解決了這個安裝卡死的問題，還會自動把 App 本體放進你的「應用程式」資料夾裡。如果你以前裝過，只要先跑 `brew uninstall usage` 刪除，再跑 `brew install --cask aqua5230/usage/usage` 就能重新裝好。就像你原本買家具遇到說明書寫錯導致螺絲鎖死，現在廠商直接派專車把組裝好的沙發送到你家客廳。
body.en: You can now smoothly install this software using Homebrew. Previously, installing this graphical App using a formula (a package format meant for text-only terminal commands) would completely fail with a frustrating `Errno::ENOENT` error due to overlapping folder paths after extraction; now, it is distributed as a cask (a package format dedicated to macOS graphical software), which not only completely fixes this installation freeze, but also automatically drops the App itself straight into your Applications folder. If you've installed it before, just run `brew uninstall usage` to remove it, and then run `brew install --cask aqua5230/usage/usage` to reinstall it properly. Like buying furniture with a misprinted manual that causes stripped screws, now the manufacturer just sends a truck to drop a fully assembled sofa right into your living room.

entries: **Homebrew install no longer fails**: because the release zip had a single top-level `usage.app` directory, Homebrew would auto-`chdir` into it and then fail to find the file to install, raising `Errno::ENOENT ... usage.app`. The formula's install path is fixed — just reinstall. (Thanks @teddy123434 for reporting #32)

**Claude Code no longer errors on startup after installing the status-line hook from the .app**: installing from the packaged .app used to write the app's bundled Python — which can't run standalone outside the bundle — into the hook config, so Claude Code threw `Could not find platform independent libraries` on startup and the status line wouldn't show. It now always uses the system `/usr/bin/python3`, and any previously corrupted config is repaired automatically on next launch or re-run of setup. (Thanks @teddy123434 for reporting #32)

title.zh-TW: Homebrew 安裝不再報錯，Claude Code 啟動不再掛點
title.en: Homebrew install path fixed, and Claude Code no longer crashes on startup after .app hook installs

body.zh-TW: 現在用 Homebrew 安裝不會再報錯，手動裝 App 的人也不用擔心配定檔壞掉了。以前如果你用 Homebrew 安裝 usage，它會因為壓縮檔的路徑問題在最後一步失敗，跳出找不到檔案的錯誤；現在路徑修好了，直接重裝就能過關。另外，如果你是把打包好的 `.app` 拖進電腦，然後按下「安裝狀態列 Hook」，這一步原本會不小心把 App 肚子裡專用的 Python 執行檔路徑寫進去，導致你打開 Claude Code 時系統找不到獨立的套件而瘋狂報錯，狀態列也出不來。現在它學乖了，一律會使用你 macOS 系統內建的 Python。如果你的設定之前已經被寫壞了也別擔心，重開一次它就會自動幫你修好。就像是修車廠以前送你一條只能插在他們廠內特殊插座上的充電線，害你開回家後插不進牆壁插座而車子發不動；現在他們直接送你一條萬用規格的線，如果之前已經給你插錯的，他們也會親自到府幫你換成對的。
body.en: Homebrew installations will no longer throw errors, and manual App installers don't have to worry about broken config files. Previously, installing usage via Homebrew would fail at the very last step due to a misaligned zip path, throwing a "file not found" error; the path is now fixed, so a simple reinstall works flawlessly. Furthermore, if you dragged the `.app` to your Mac and clicked "Install Status-Line Hook", it used to accidentally write the path to the app's internal, bundled Python interpreter into your config. Because that internal Python can't run independently outside the bundle, Claude Code would completely panic on startup, throwing errors about missing libraries and refusing to show the status line. It now strictly uses your Mac's built-in system Python. If your config was already corrupted by the old version, don't worry—it automatically repairs itself the next time you launch or re-run the setup. It's like a car dealership handing you a proprietary charging cable that only fits the sockets inside their showroom, leaving you stranded with a dead car at home; now they hand you a universal cable, and if they gave you the wrong one earlier, they'll magically swap it out for the right one.

**Homebrew install no longer fails**: because the release zip had a single top-level `usage.app` directory, Homebrew would auto-`chdir` into it and then fail to find the file to install, raising `Errno::ENOENT ... usage.app`. The formula's install path is fixed — just reinstall. (Thanks @teddy123434 for reporting #32)
**Claude Code no longer errors on startup after installing the status-line hook from the .app**: installing from the packaged .app used to write the app's bundled Python — which can't run standalone outside the bundle — into the hook config, so Claude Code threw `Could not find platform independent libraries` on startup and the status line wouldn't show. It now always uses the system `/usr/bin/python3`, and any previously corrupted config is repaired automatically on next launch or re-run of setup. (Thanks @teddy123434 for reporting #32)
